summary: Koei Tecmo and Omega Force's Three Kingdoms action series, covering the original PlayStation fighter, main musou sequels, Xtreme Legends and Empires branches, portable entries, mobile/online spin-offs, and Origins.

entries.title: Dynasty Warriors

primary.why: The first Dynasty Warriors is a one-on-one PlayStation fighting game and has no modern remaster route documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation release through DuckStation at high internal resolution.

all_releases.reason: primary: only documented release route.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a fighting game and is distinct from the later musou formula.

entries.title: Dynasty Warriors 2

primary.why: Dynasty Warriors 2 introduced the musou formula internationally and is documented as a PS2 release.
primary.how_to_play: Play through PCSX2 at high internal resolution.

all_releases.reason: primary: only documented release route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not confuse with the 1997 fighting game.

entries.title: Dynasty Warriors 3

emulation.notes: Prefer Xbox for fidelity, PS2 for compatibility.

primary.why: Dynasty Warriors 3 shipped on PS2 and Xbox; until the 2026 remaster releases, the Xbox route has the best fidelity ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox version through xemu if compatibility is acceptable; use PCSX2 for PS2 fallback.

all_releases.reason: primary: Xbox offers the best fidelity ceiling; PS2 is fallback.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: A Complete Edition remaster is announced for October 1, 2026, after the current archive date, so it is tracked separately as future needs-research.

entries.remaster_caveats: Revisit after Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered launches.

all_releases.reason: skip: superseded for fidelity by the PC Hyper port.

all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity route for the base game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Hyper is the preferred base-game route; Xtreme Legends and Empires are separate entries.

entries.remaster_caveats: Expansion content lives in Xtreme Legends/Empires, not Hyper itself.
